author: D00ZiE
body:
This map was originally an idea produced by glitchy1 and I. It is made with three seperate levels, Hell, Earth, and Heaven. Each team can PvP on each level without having to worry about taking fall damage. If you look around the map enough you'll also find some hidden items :D This map is meant to play like gladiator in the way that is it TDM without being 1 hit kill. 


[Info]
-4 teams
-11 people per team 

[Builders]
D00ZiE
glitchy1
Azazel34
AlexanderJoe10 (Thanks for the server m8)
AwarriorVenom

[Loadout]


[Download] http://www.mediafire.com/download/s7b72nhz1rwq7t4/JewAndGlit.rar

[Yaml] Coming Soon :)

[Album] http://imgur.com/a/FIqUa
